text:
sec-bot: Scanner alert: KMS-wrapped object contains high-entropy base64 that matches AWS key shape. bucket=gs://ingest-temp/2026-04-02/payload.enc ; wrapping_key=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap :warning:

maya: @rick @paul can you triage? Looks like our service performed server-side wrap at 06:03 UTC.

rick: taking. metadata shows uploader svc-external-collector; our ingest called KMS Encrypt after receive. likely plaintext upstream. first containment: revoke collector SA keys, create new key-version for ingest-wrap, block writes to the prefix.

paul: doing revocation now. sanitized command run:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable a1b2c3d4 --iam-account=svc-external-collector@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Added IAM deny for storage.objects.create for that SA. writes stopped at 06:07 UTC.

maya: plan: 1) new KMS key-version + mark primary (rick) 2) rewrap affected objects into rewrapped bucket (rick+paul) 3) change ingest agent to client-side envelope encrypt and redact logs (paul) 4) preserve evidence and open legal case (maya/legal) 5) forward KMS decrypts for ingest-wrap to sec-audit for 120d (maya).

rick: creating new key version now and scheduling rewrap job. rewrap will decrypt with old version and encrypt with new primary; writing to gs://ingest-rewrapped with metadata rewrap=true. estimate 90m for priority set.

paul: small patch to agent ready: add AES-GCM envelope encryption and drop body logs. PR internal/ingest/pull/998. will hold rollout until rewrap completes. also adding a lint to reject uploads containing aws_access_key patterns.

legal: evidence hold created: CASE-2026-0421. advising minimal partner communication: notify that their upload likely contained secrets and request retention of related CI logs.

maya: owners/eta: rick (key-version + rewrap kickoff) 10m -> rewrap 90m; paul (agent PR + log redaction) 30m PR, rollout after rewrap; maya (audit forwarder + partner notice) 45m; legal (evidence hold) 5m.

paul: rewrap job started: 0/150 objects done, will report progress.

maya: keep notes here. after rewrap we will rotate any downstream credentials that may reference archived values and confirm no CI artifact copies remain. :white_check_mark:
